description: This file defines a report parser class for account analytic journal reports in Odoo, including methods to fetch and sum journal lines within date ranges.

classes.name: account_analytic_journal
classes.description: Report parser class for account analytic journal, providing methods to retrieve and sum journal lines.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser with context-specific data and updates local context with helper functions.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Fetches distinct move IDs from account analytic lines within a date range and journal, returning corresponding account move lines.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Retrieves analytic line records for a specific move ID and journal within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_general
methods.description: Calculates the sum of debit minus credit from account move lines linked to analytic lines within a date range and journal.

methods.name: _sum_analytic
methods.description: Calculates the total amount from analytic lines within a date range and journal.
